default_rules: A PASS covers only the exact fact and locator, not all hardware functionality
Reset numeric certainty is separate from access and legal input
Read-only does not imply constant snapshot while hardware events occur
An undocumented illegal-input response is EXCLUDE, not clamping/ignore/zero
Conditional dynamic rules require declared event and completion semantics
An empty/no-event assertion set is SKIP, never positive source certification
All source conflicts remain unresolved and disputed aspects excluded from the main oracle
Mandatory default writes are stimulus constraints, not evidence of writability
Do not use this schema with the old protocol_rules parser
